title: VPS Monitoring & Linux Server Alerts
excerpt: Monitor CPU, memory, and disk across your Linux VPSs. Track resource history and get email or Slack alerts with vpsmon Cloud. No inbound ports required.
content_html:
Track CPU, memory, disk use, and uptime across your Linux servers. Review past readings and get alerts for resource limits or missing agent updates.

A disk alert in practice

  1. 01

  2. 02

  3. 03

Continue to setup ↗

  1. Create an account

    Sign up, then choose Add server in the dashboard.

  2. Install the agent

    Copy the install command and one-use token. Run the command on your Linux VPS to connect it to Cloud.

  3. Open your dashboard

    Select the server to view its readings.

All servers, one view

Check which agents are reporting and compare their latest readings.

See past resource use

Review CPU, memory, and disk history to investigate spikes.

Track incidents

Track sustained CPU or memory alerts, disk limits, and missing agent updates through recovery.

No inbound port

Each server gets its own token. Its agent sends metrics to Cloud over outbound HTTPS.

Choose your plan

A separate dashboard you run on your own server.

  • Single-server dashboard
  • Metrics stay on your server
  • No Cloud account required
